chalisa.do1: Placing on my head the dust of the lotus feet of Śiva, Viśveśvara,
I describe your fair fame, O Annapūrṇā, bringing to it a poet's mind.
chalisa.cau1: Mother, you ever bring bliss, renowned for your bearing that grants boons and freedom from fear.
chalisa.cau2: Victory to the ocean of beauty, mother of the world, remover of all sin, remover of the fear of worldly existence.
chalisa.cau3: On your white body are white garments too; saints, seers and sages serve your feet.
chalisa.cau4: Mother, you are the sovereign of the city of Kāśī, Māheśvarī, protector of the whole world.
chalisa.cau5: You ride the bull, and your name is Rudrāṇī; victory to the auspicious one who moves through the world.
chalisa.cau6: The daughter of the mountain attained the rank of crest-jewel among wives devoted to their husbands.
chalisa.cau7: She could not bear the grief of separation from her husband; then with the fire of yoga she burnt her body.
chalisa.cau8: As she gave up her body she kept her love for Śiva's feet, and by it she came to the house of the Himālaya.
chalisa.cau9: She was born and was named Girijā; great joy filled the palace.
chalisa.cau10: Then Nārada misled you, and schooled you in a lesson about your marriage.
chalisa.cau11: He named Brahmā, Varuṇa, Kubera, Indra, king of the gods, and others, and sang their praises.
chalisa.cau12: Extolling the fame of all the gods, he resolved in his mind to turn your mind.
chalisa.cau13: Blessed one, you stood firm in your vow; the daughter of the Himālaya made it good.
chalisa.cau14: Then Nārada grew alarmed within himself, and taught you the mantra that fulfils the vow.
chalisa.cau15: He instructed you to perform austerities; you weighed the saint's words and held them true.
chalisa.cau16: Even on hearing the voice from the sky, you would not be turned aside, though urged to; then Brahmā came to you.
chalisa.cau17: He said: Daughter, ask for an incomparable boon; today I shall give it as your mind desires.
chalisa.cau18: You have performed great austerities beyond this world; though so very delicate, you have borne hardship.
chalisa.cau19: Now set aside your doubt and ask something of me; I swear it, there is no deceit in me towards you.
chalisa.cau20: Know me as Brahmā, who brings forth the Vedas and knows them; accept these words of mine as true.
chalisa.cau21: Leave your hesitation and tell me your wish; I shall give you whatever gift your heart desires.
chalisa.cau22: Hearing Brahmā's sweet words, a faint smile came to Bhavānī's face.
chalisa.cau23: She said: Creator, what are you saying? You are the maker and sustainer of the world.
chalisa.cau24: My wish is not hidden from you; what do you want to make me say?
chalisa.cau25: When I was dying at Dakṣa's sacrifice, my wish was that Lord Śiva should be mine again.
chalisa.cau26: May I now win him, the one my heart loves. Saying: So be it, Brahmā went to his abode.
chalisa.cau27: Then, Girijā, Śaṅkara became yours, and the doubt about the fruit of your wish was gone.
chalisa.cau28: The light of ten million moons and ten million suns dwells in your face.
chalisa.cau29: A rosary, a book and a goad shine in your hands, and the noose in your other hand enchants the mind.
chalisa.cau30: O Annapūrṇā, ever full, unborn, faultless, endless, O Aparṇā.
chalisa.cau31: Mother, you are all grace and bring welfare; Mother, you are full of the world's riches and of bliss.
chalisa.cau32: O lotus-eyed, radiant maiden; O goddess, O Kālikā, O Caṇḍī, O terrible one.
chalisa.cau33: On Kailāsa you became Girijā, and as the ocean-born Lakṣmī you shone in joy.
chalisa.cau34: In heaven you were called Mahālakṣmī; in the world of mortals you attained the rank of Lakṣmī.
chalisa.cau35: You shine in all as the form of all; the kings of the city of the immortals serve you.
chalisa.cau36: Those who read this Chālīsā of yours will gain auspicious fruit; Śiva is witness to it.
chalisa.cau37: Those who read it in the morning with their minds intent, growing in devotion and delight,
chalisa.cau38: will win, with wife, husband, friends and sons, the wondrous gain of supreme prosperity.
chalisa.cau39: This reading gets a kingdom for one deprived of his kingdom; your fame increases the good name of your devotee.
chalisa.cau40: The reading gives great joy and blessing; by it the devotee obtains the treasure his heart desires.
chalisa.do2: Those who read this lovely Chālīsā and bow their heads
will have all their works fulfilled; Śiva, Lord of Kāśī, is witness.
